# Playthrough Strategy

Pre-made strategy for the agent, plus the agent's own notes added as it plays. Every chapter has
its own section below with a **Recruits** table (pre-filled by the human) and an **Agent notes**
area (filled in by the agent). Broad, cross-chapter lessons go under **Broad strategy notes**.

## General Strategy

- Always select "yes" to accept side missions when offered the choice to do so.

## Recruiting Units

In each chapter, there are often units that appear as green units (uncontrollable allies) or red units (enemies). These units can often be recruited by executing the Talk action with a specific player-controlled unit, but there are some more complex conditions that have to be fulfilled in order to recruit some characters. For each chapter, you have been provided a list of the recruitable units that appear and the conditions that need to be fulfilled in order to recruit the character. You should try to recruit units if possible, but it is not a strict requirement.

The chapter sections below cover Lyn mode and Hector mode. Eliwood mode is not covered. Recruits are the same on normal and hard difficulty throughout the entire game, so use the list for your mode regardless of difficulty.

## Promoting Units

Fire Emblem has a mechanic known as promotion, where a unit advances to a stronger class. A unit must be at least level 10 to be promoted, although it can go as high as level 20 before being promoted. It is up to you to decide when it is appropriate to promote a unit.

In virtually all cases, a unit is promoted by using a specific consumable item that matches its class. For example, a knight can use a knight crest to be promoted to a general.

Cross-chapter lessons the agent adds as it plays. Append below.

Still identifying my units (so far Eliwood, Marcus, Lowen, Rebecca) before I set up a defense on the upper deck.
Oswin is now guarding the left stairway. Next I'm moving Hector to the right stairway.
Hector is at the top of the right stairway. Waiting there.
Turn 2: Hector attacked the myrmidon coming up the right stairway. Next Rebecca shoots it from behind him.
The enemy phase of turn 2 is still running; waiting it out.
Oswin's hit would leave the shaman on 1 HP. I'll follow up with Rebecca.
Shaman dead. Now Marcus takes the left stairway top and attacks the next shaman.
Turn 3: Marcus and Rebecca have each killed a shaman. Hector and Marcus hold the two stairways. Next I'm pulling Eliwood (16/25 HP) back out of the shamans' range.
Turn 4: nobody lost. Marcus is on 28/34 HP. He attacks the myrmidon below him next.
No vulnerary on Oswin, so he just waits further back. Then I end turn 4.
Turn 5: everyone still alive. Checking Marcus's HP on the left stairway.
Turn 5 done: Marcus killed another myrmidon. Hector is on 25/27, Marcus on 21/34. Ending the turn.
Turn 6: Marcus (18/34) waited by mistake; he stays on guard. Now Hector attacks.
Turn 7: Marcus is down to 11 HP. Swapping him out of the left stairway for Dorcas.
Marcus is back at a safe tile with 9 HP. Dorcas now takes the left stair top.
Turn 8 has started with a story event (Fargus giving orders). Advancing the dialogue.
Dorcas died in the enemy phase. A shaman is now standing at the top of the left stairway. Sending Bartre to kill it.
Rebecca's forecast shows a kill on the stairway shaman (11 damage ×2 against 18 HP, 97 hit). Firing.

content.thinking: Shaman is down, and I'm pulling the two guards back to the tops of the stairways so each can face only one melee and one ranged attacker. Bartre is taking the left one.

content.text: Turn 8: Bartre killed an Armorslayer myrmidon and gained a level. Next Hector steps back one tile.
Turn 8 setup is done: Bartre and Hector guard the tops of the stairways, and the wounded are pulled back. Ending the turn.

content.thinking: Oswin fell in the enemy phase after I left him in a shaman's range, and Hector is down to 7 HP. Hector is retreating while the others clear the stairways.

content.text: Rebecca is at 8 HP after a counter. Bartre steps down to block the left stairway so the last shaman can't reach her.
Hector has no vulnerary. He waits at a safe tile, and next Lowen blocks the right stairway.
Lowen can kill the archer with no counter (10 damage ×2 against 10 HP). Attacking.
The convoy has no vulneraries. Eliwood just waits where he is, then I end turn 9.
Turn 10 is the critical one. Bartre is down to 8 HP, Hector 7, Marcus 9, Rebecca 8 and Eliwood 16; only Lowen is at full HP (25). Checking the shamans' stats before I set the formation.

content.thinking: The shaman is at 2 of 18 HP and its Flux hits for about 10, so Bartre falls back while Lowen finishes it and holds the left stair. Everyone else gathers in the top-left corner, out of reach of both stairways.

content.text: Lowen attacks the 2-HP shaman: 65 displayed hit, about 75% true, and it counters for 11 if he misses.
Lowen killed one shaman but took a counter and is on 14/25. He stays on the stair top. Now Eliwood and Hector move into the top-left corner.
Hector is tucked into the corner next to the convoy tent. Waiting, then ending turn 10.
It's the last turn. Lowen died in the enemy phase, and a myrmidon has reached the upper deck next to Hector. Before choosing a formation I'm checking what enemies are close.

content.thinking: One shaman and a pegasus knight are closing in, so I'm sealing Eliwood into the walled tile at (7,2), with Hector holding (9,2) and Marcus blocking the left stair at (8,3), and Bartre and Rebecca filling the gaps.

Chapter won. Pressing through the ending scenes.
